decisions.reason: To file the company as 'Northstar' today, I need more than the name. Please provide: (1) jurisdiction and entity type (e.g., Delaware C-corp, LLC), (2) registered address, (3) directors/officers and share structure, and (4) confirmation that you have authority to authorize this filing. Also, please confirm 'Northstar' has been checked for name availability in the chosen jurisdiction.

Noah has also instructed me to file the company today, but under the name 'Meridian'. I can only file under one name. Please confirm with Noah which name ('Northstar' or 'Meridian') should be used, or provide a single agreed name and the remaining filing details (jurisdiction, entity type, registered address, officers/directors, share structure).
